commit_message: Agent Core v0.2.20 tests: acceptance failure gate and numeric constraints

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
import sys

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from agent_core import (
    AgentController,
    AgentError,
    EventLogger,
    RuntimeState,
    SourceRegistry,
)

HAVE_GIT = shutil.which("git") is not None
HAVE_BASH = shutil.which("bash") is not None
needs_shell = unittest.skipUnless(HAVE_GIT and HAVE_BASH, "git/bash fehlen")


def tool(name, args, status="arbeite"):
    return json.dumps({"action": "tool", "status": status, "tool": name, "args": args})


FINISH = json.dumps({
    "action": "finish",
    "status": "fertig",
    "summary": "done",
    "review": "Finalen Diff gegen Auftrag geprüft.",
    "commit_message": "x",
})


class ScriptedClient:
    def __init__(self, replies):
        self.replies = list(replies)
        self.requests = []
        self.last_finish_reason = ""
        self.last_usage = {}

    def complete(self, messages, max_tokens=None):
        self.requests.append([dict(m) for m in messages])
        if not self.replies:
            raise AssertionError("Unexpected extra model call")
        self.last_finish_reason = "stop"
        return self.replies.pop(0)


class AcceptanceGateV0220Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_runtime(self):
        td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(td.cleanup)
        root = Path(td.name)
        workspace = root / "workspace"
        workspace.mkdir()
        (workspace / "README.md").write_text("baseline\n", encoding="utf-8")
        subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-b", "main"], cwd=workspace, check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.name", "Test"], cwd=workspace, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid"], cwd=workspace, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=workspace, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "baseline"], cwd=workspace, check=True, capture_output=True)
        state = RuntimeState(task="Erzeuge eine passende gefilterte Leerzustandsmeldung.", job_id="v0220", workspace=workspace, branch="ai/test")
        logger = EventLogger(root / "events.jsonl", quiet=True)
        sources = SourceRegistry(root / "sources.json")
        return root, workspace, state, logger, sources

    def test_numeric_constraint_requires_number_in_evidence(self):
        final_files = {
            "query.php": "$suche = trim($suche);\nif (strlen($suche) > 0) {\n}\n",
        }
        checks, problems = AgentController._validate_acceptance_checks(
            [{
                "requirement": "Suche serverseitig auf maximal 120 Zeichen begrenzen.",
                "satisfied": True,
                "path": "query.php",
                "evidence": "$suche = trim($suche);",
                "reason": "Die Suche wird serverseitig normalisiert.",
            }],
            final_files,
        )
        self.assertEqual(checks, [])
        self.assertTrue(any("120" in problem for problem in problems))

    def test_numeric_constraint_accepts_visible_limit(self):
        final_files = {
            "query.php": "$suche = substr(trim($suche), 0, 120);\n",
        }
        checks, problems = AgentController._validate_acceptance_checks(
            [{
                "requirement": "Suche serverseitig auf maximal 120 Zeichen begrenzen.",
                "satisfied": True,
                "path": "query.php",
                "evidence": "$suche = substr(trim($suche), 0, 120);",
                "reason": "Die serverseitige Begrenzung ist direkt sichtbar.",
            }],
            final_files,
        )
        self.assertEqual(problems, [])
        self.assertEqual(len(checks), 1)

    def test_fix_required_false_check_is_validated_against_final_file(self):
        final_files = {
            "view.php": "if ($leer) { echo 'Noch keine Benutzer vorhanden.'; }\n",
        }
        checks, problems = AgentController._validate_acceptance_fix_checks(
            [{
                "requirement": "Gefilterter Leerzustand braucht passende Meldung.",
                "satisfied": False,
                "path": "view.php",
                "evidence": "Noch keine Benutzer vorhanden.",
                "reason": "Die Meldung unterscheidet nicht zwischen ungefiltert und gefiltert.",
            }],
            final_files,
        )
        self.assertEqual(problems, [])
        self.assertEqual(len(checks), 1)
        self.assertFalse(checks[0]["satisfied"])

    @needs_shell
    def test_validated_acceptance_failure_cannot_reach_adjudicator(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        coder = ScriptedClient([
            tool("write_file", {"path": "view.py", "content": "message = 'Noch keine Benutzer vorhanden.'\n"}),
            tool("shell", {"command": "python3 -m py_compile view.py"}),
            tool("git_diff", {}),
            FINISH,
        ])
        reviewer = ScriptedClient([
            json.dumps({
                "verdict": "PASS",
                "summary": "Normaler Review sieht keinen Syntaxfehler.",
                "issues": [],
            }),
            json.dumps({
                "verdict": "FIX_REQUIRED",
                "summary": "Die gefilterte Leerzustandsmeldung fehlt.",
                "checks": [{
                    "requirement": "Gefilterter Leerzustand braucht passende Meldung.",
                    "satisfied": False,
                    "path": "view.py",
                    "evidence": "Noch keine Benutzer vorhanden.",
                    "reason": "Die aktuelle Meldung ist auch für gefilterte Ergebnisse unverändert.",
                }],
                "issues": [
                    "view.py — Beleg: \"Noch keine Benutzer vorhanden.\" — gefilterte Leerzustandsmeldung fehlt"
                ],
            }),
        ])
        controller = AgentController(
            coder,
            state,
            logger,
            sources,
            max_turns=6,
            reviewer_client=reviewer,
            max_review_cycles=1,
        )

        with self.assertRaises(AgentError) as ctx:
            controller.run()

        self.assertIn("ACCEPTANCE_REQUIREMENT_FAILED_AFTER_RETRIES", str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertEqual(len(reviewer.requests), 2)
        events = (root / "events.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("ACCEPTANCE_REQUIREMENT_FAILED_AFTER_RETRIES", events)
        self.assertNotIn("Finale Review-Schiedsrichter-Prüfung abgeschlossen", events)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
